label: Figure 20.7: The original Phillips curve
alt: Downward-sloping convex curve with unemployment rate on the horizontal axis and rate of change of wages on the vertical axis: fast wage growth when unemployment is low, wage growth near zero or negative when unemployment is high.
caption: Phillips’s original relationship: the rate of change of money wages falls as the unemployment rate rises. The convex curve is steep at low unemployment (wages rise quickly) and flattens as unemployment grows, crossing zero wage growth at a moderate rate of unemployment.
